cutover_criteria.criterion: Every v1 requirement has a source-backed Phase 11 evidence row with current status, cutover status, retained-code posture, intentional-delta handling, and required non-local evidence.
cutover_criteria.blocking_reason: No local mapping blocker remains, but final demotion is still blocked until aggregate, non-local, retained-code, and maintainer acceptance evidence is attached.
required_evidence: All requirement evidence rows remain valid under the aggregate Phase 11 verifier.
Maintainer review accepts remaining cutover blockers by evidence class before demotion.

cutover_criteria.criterion: The aggregate Phase 11 local verifier, security scan, Rust contract checks, Bazel labels, and just facade all pass in the final verification plan.
cutover_criteria.blocking_reason: Phase 11 aggregate verifier, Bazel wiring, just facade, and validation sign-off passed locally; final demotion remains blocked by non-local evidence and maintainer acceptance criteria.
required_evidence: Bazel and just facade proof that Phase 11 verifier tests run before aggregate verification.

cutover_criteria.criterion: Simulator, CI, release-candidate, hardware-smoke, manual hardware, live network/TLS, storage-media, MMU, RS485, toolchanger, and signing-sensitive evidence gates are named instead of treated as local proof.
cutover_criteria.blocking_reason: The gate inventory is locally present, but each non-local evidence item must still be attached or accepted before reference demotion.
required_evidence: Approved simulator logs for GUI, storage, protocol, network, and auxiliary flows.
Hardware or manual evidence for startup, safety, motion, thermal, USB/media, MMU, RS485, toolchanger, and auxiliary update gates.
Live network/TLS/API evidence with credential and certificate details recorded by name only.
Release-candidate and signing-sensitive evidence stored as approved artifact names only.

cutover_criteria.criterion: Every residual C, C++, ASM, generated, vendor, runtime, filesystem, network, USB, auxiliary, and reference-oracle island has an owner, boundary, retained-code disposition, and source-backed justification.
cutover_criteria.blocking_reason: Retained-code rows are added by Plan 11-04 Task 2 and still require maintainer acceptance before reference demotion.
required_evidence: Retained-code justification manifest with exactly the eight D-15 rows.
Maintainer acceptance, blocker resolution, or explicit deferral for each retained island.

cutover_criteria.criterion: Known defects and fragile areas from the codebase concern ledger and Phase 6 through Phase 10 concern manifests are preserved, fixed with tests, accepted as retained behavior, or blocked.
cutover_criteria.blocking_reason: Local concern disposition evidence is present, while final cutover remains blocked until aggregate review confirms no v1 blocker is hidden.
required_evidence: Known-concern disposition rows remain lifecycle-tagged and source-backed.
Any future fix claim must cite tests or approved non-local evidence.

cutover_criteria.criterion: Phase 11 manifests, validation records, and summaries avoid secret markers, local hardware/simulator proof overclaims, ungrounded byte identity wording, final demotion claims, and source path escapes.
cutover_criteria.blocking_reason: Security-only and aggregate Phase 11 scans pass locally; final cutover remains blocked until non-local release, hardware, simulator, live network/TLS, storage-media, and maintainer acceptance evidence is attached.
required_evidence: Security-only scan passes after cutover and retained-code manifests are present.
Aggregate verifier reruns after final Phase 11 wiring and summary artifacts exist.

cutover_criteria.criterion: The CMake/C++ reference path remains visible and guarded until all parity gates, retained-code review, non-local evidence, release-candidate evidence, and maintainer acceptance criteria are satisfied.
cutover_criteria.blocking_reason: CMake/C++ reference path demotion remains blocked until all local, CI, simulator, hardware-smoke, manual-hardware-required, retained-code, and release-candidate criteria are attached and accepted.
required_evidence: All local and non-local parity gates attached or formally accepted.
Retained-code review accepted or blocked with explicit owner decisions.
Maintainer approval recorded before any reference path demotion work is planned.

known_concern_dispositions.phase11_handling: Known defects such as probe-classifier coupling, home-screen flash start freeze, crash-dump handling, RNG fallback, STM32G0 IRQ behavior, and MMU availability remain visible in source-backed concern rows until an approved intentional delta with tests or non-local proof replaces the reference behavior.
known_concern_dispositions.regression_guard: Phase 11 cutover evidence must continue citing the Phase 1 ledger and Phase 6/8/10 concern manifests before accepting any demotion decision.

known_concern_dispositions.phase11_handling: Startup, clocks, interrupts, watchdogs, thermal and motion safety, storage media timing, USB behavior, RS485, MMU, toolchanger, auxiliary update, and physical UI proof remain non-local evidence gates and are not converted into local pass claims.
known_concern_dispositions.regression_guard: Any final readiness row that changes hardware or simulator proof to local evidence must cite actual approved artifact names and maintain name-only redaction.

known_concern_dispositions.phase11_handling: Wi-Fi, PrusaLink, Connect, TLS, crash-dump, signing, firmware image, and auxiliary payload evidence is represented by source path, key name, status name, or artifact name only; checked-in manifests do not carry secret values, certificate bytes, signing material, raw dump contents, or firmware package bytes.
known_concern_dispositions.regression_guard: python3 tools/bazel/phase11_verify.py --security-only must pass before metadata completion and again during aggregate Plan 11 verification.

known_concern_dispositions.phase11_handling: Reference comparisons remain normalized semantic contracts unless a deterministic fixture and normalization rule are named; release bytes, firmware package bytes, and signing-sensitive bytes stay outside local evidence.
known_concern_dispositions.regression_guard: Comparison rows must keep byte_identity_claim false unless a deterministic fixture and normalization rule are present, and the security scan must reject forbidden overclaim phrases.

known_concern_dispositions.phase11_handling: CMake/C++ remains the guarded reference oracle and comparison source. Plan 11-04 records demotion criteria but does not remove, hide, or default-enable demotion of reference paths.
known_concern_dispositions.regression_guard: criteria-reference-demotion-blocked must keep status not-cutover-ready and demotion_allowed false until all local, non-local, retained-code, release-candidate, and maintainer acceptance evidence is attached.
